question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT bw.bowler, p.player_name, bw.wickets, br.runs_conceded, 
       br.runs_conceded * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
